parent: Phase-24 established structured rank-6 sufficiency on wave, Gray-Scott, NLS and linear advection
question: Does the frozen context-only identifier transfer to a fifth unseen nonlinear-flux PDE, and if not is the bottleneck the missing center-times-spatial interaction class rather than token capacity?

new_family.name: two_component_viscous_burgers_2d
new_family.discretization: periodic centered first differences plus 5-point Laplacian; explicit Euler

primary_identifier.spatial_basis: full fixed real orthonormal 3x3 DFT, rank 9 per channel
primary_identifier.features: constant + 18 linear spatial Fourier coordinates + seven center degree-2/3 monomials
primary_identifier.recursive_projection: frozen Phase-10 18-bit companded token projection after every step

secondary_interaction_diagnostic.construction: the frozen 26 features plus every product between center u or v and each of the 18 linear spatial Fourier coordinates (36 generic center-times-spatial interaction terms)
secondary_interaction_diagnostic.purpose: contains generic multiplicative local-flux interactions without naming Burgers derivatives; diagnostic only and cannot rescue primary failure

primary_rule: PASS only if the frozen 26-feature token model beats raw-state persistence on all four Burgers tests in all three fresh registered replicates (12/12 cells). Any one ratio >=1.0 makes Phase 25 primary transfer FAIL. No retries or replacement seeds.
diagnostic_interpretation: If primary fails while the 62-feature raw-context diagnostic strongly beats persistence, interpret the dominant boundary as hypothesis-class insufficiency. If raw 62 also fails, do not attribute failure to tokens alone. Token-62 performance is reported separately.
failure_policy: All registered outcomes are retained. Secondary diagnostics cannot redefine the primary gate. No Burgers data enters tokenizer fitting.
collision_policy: If any 825250xxx registered seed collides with a previously consumed registered seed before execution, stop before consuming it and preregister a repair namespace only for unconsumed seeds.
claim_limit: Known synthetic Burgers dynamics only. This tests representational and system-identification structure; it is not discovery of new physics or a universal scientific model.
